title: Towards Baruya manhood. Part 1. Village life I
creator_credit: Ian Dunlop, John Martin-Jones and Film Australia
brief_description: The first of a series of nine films about Baruya village life, social organisation, and agriculture. The Baruya belong to the Anga group of tribes of the Eastern Highlands of New Guinea.
